_comment: ABNF conformance cases for the did:aria method-specific identifier, per spec §03.1. Every implementation that parses or validates a did:aria identifier MUST accept every case in `accept` and reject every case in `reject`, with the stated reason. Shared source of truth: implementations do not share code (Rust, TypeScript, Python, Go), they share this file.

accept.note: principal has verified its own domain (L1+)
organizational identity without verified domain; no host prefix, so the identifier survives a registry migration
hyphens are legal inside the slug
digits are legal in the slug

reject.reason: agent-slug is lowercase-only; uppercase is not in the production alphabet
agent-slug MUST NOT end with a hyphen
agent-slug MUST start with lowercase or digit
underscore is not in the agent-slug alphabet
bare domain is not a valid identifier; a principal must carry the :org suffix
registry-account MUST carry the u- prefix
registry-account MUST be exactly 8 characters after the u- prefix
registry-account MUST be exactly 8 characters after the u- prefix
the :org suffix is reserved for principals; an agent-slug MUST NOT equal 'org', and the principal registry form carries no host prefix
dns-label MUST NOT start with a hyphen (RFC 1035 §2.3.1)
dns-label MUST NOT end with a hyphen (RFC 1035 §2.3.1)
too many components for any defined shape
